fields.question_text: This 1994 Disney animated film features Simba and the song 'Hakuna Matata.'
fields.hint: Set in the African savanna; the hero is a young lion prince.

fields.question_text: Howard alumnus Chadwick Boseman starred as this Marvel superhero whose kingdom is Wakanda.
fields.hint: A 2018 Ryan Coogler film; the hero's alter ego is T'Challa.

fields.question_text: This 1972 Francis Ford Coppola film follows the Corleone crime family.
fields.hint: Marlon Brando plays the family patriarch Don Vito.

fields.question_text: This 2020 Pixar film features a jazz musician named Joe Gardner who falls into the Great Before.
fields.hint: One-syllable title; Jamie Foxx voices the lead.

fields.question_text: This 1993 Spielberg blockbuster features cloned dinosaurs running loose on an island park.
fields.hint: Based on a Michael Crichton novel; famous for a T-Rex scene in the rain.

fields.question_text: This NBC sitcom ran from 1994 to 2004 and followed six friends living in New York City.
fields.hint: Ross and Rachel were the iconic will-they-won't-they couple.

fields.question_text: This HBO fantasy epic is based on George R.R. Martin's 'A Song of Ice and Fire.'
fields.hint: Features House Stark, House Lannister, and dragons.

fields.question_text: Howard alumna Phylicia Rashad played Clair Huxtable on this 1980s NBC sitcom.
fields.hint: Set in Brooklyn; focused on a Black upper-middle-class family.

fields.question_text: This mockumentary sitcom is set at the Scranton branch of Dunder Mifflin Paper Company.
fields.hint: Steve Carell plays the regional manager; Jim and Pam fall in love.

fields.question_text: This AMC drama follows Walter White's transformation into a meth kingpin named Heisenberg.
fields.hint: Set in Albuquerque; Bryan Cranston stars alongside Aaron Paul.

fields.question_text: This British band released 'Hey Jude' and 'Let It Be' in the late 1960s.
fields.hint: Liverpool-born; members included John, Paul, George, and Ringo.

fields.question_text: This Howard attendee and Bad Boy Records founder released the album 'No Way Out' in 1997.
fields.hint: Also known as Puff Daddy or Sean Combs.

fields.question_text: This 1982 Michael Jackson album is the best-selling album of all time.
fields.hint: Title track features a famous music video with zombies.

fields.question_text: This Compton rapper released the critically acclaimed 'To Pimp a Butterfly' in 2015.
fields.hint: Won a Pulitzer Prize in 2018 for his album 'DAMN.'

fields.question_text: This music genre emerged in the Bronx in the 1970s, combining DJing, MCing, and breakdancing.
fields.hint: DJ Kool Herc is credited as one of its originators.

fields.question_text: This media mogul hosts a book club and built an empire from a daytime talk show based in Chicago.
fields.hint: Her talk show ran for 25 seasons.

fields.question_text: This Howard alumna played Cookie Lyon on 'Empire' and starred in 'Hidden Figures.'
fields.hint: Was nominated for an Oscar for 'The Curious Case of Benjamin Button.'

fields.question_text: This German-born physicist proposed E=mc² and won the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics.
fields.hint: Famous for his wild white hair and the theory of relativity.

fields.question_text: This English actor starred as Newt Scamander in the 'Fantastic Beasts' film series.
fields.hint: Won an Oscar playing Stephen Hawking in 'The Theory of Everything.'

fields.question_text: This Nobel laureate author wrote 'Beloved' and 'Song of Solomon,' and taught at Howard University.
fields.hint: First Black woman to win the Nobel Prize in Literature (1993).

fields.question_text: This Olympic event category includes the 100m, 200m, and 400m sprints.
fields.hint: Also known as athletics internationally.

fields.question_text: LeBron James has spent his entire career playing this professional sport.
fields.hint: Five players per team; the ball goes through a hoop.

fields.question_text: Howard University's athletic teams are nicknamed this large North American mammal.
fields.hint: Also known as buffalo; the largest land mammal in North America.

fields.question_text: Tom Brady won this many Super Bowls during his NFL career, an all-time record.
fields.hint: One more than six, one less than eight.

fields.question_text: This American tennis player has won 23 Grand Slam singles titles, the most in the Open Era.
fields.hint: Her older sister Venus is also a tennis legend.
